skill.name: god-init
skill.description: Set up Godpowers in a repository or migrate an existing 6.x project. Record the project goal and next step, run the project check, and inspect hook registration.
skill.summary: Initialize or migrate a Godpowers project and check that its verification command works and its hooks are registered.
skill.author: hannsxpeter

security_audit.summary: The backticks mark Markdown code, but all four findings describe real third-party package execution without an npm confirmation prompt or an exact version pin. The migration previews changes but does not wait for approval before editing repository instruction files. No evidence of malicious intent was found in the skill files.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs a third-party npm package from a floating major version and skips the npm confirmation prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an exact reviewed release and obtain approval before the first package invocation, including status and dry runs.

remediation.issue: The migration can change shared repository instructions without explicit approval after the preview.
remediation.suggestion: Show the files and instruction blocks that will change, then wait for approval before applying the migration.

remediation.issue: Setup runs a project check without a step to review the exact command.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact detected or supplied check command for approval before running it, and explain any hook changes.

Initialization runs the mutable third-party package without npm confirmation and can configure a project-specific check command. The Markdown itself does not execute code.
Verification and hook diagnostics both invoke the mutable third-party package without npm confirmation. Verification also runs a project check with the agent's permissions.

content.user_title: Set Up or Migrate a Godpowers Project
content.value_statement: Setting up Godpowers or moving from version 6 can leave project state, verification, and hooks unchecked. This skill guides setup or migration and checks the resulting configuration.
actual_capabilities: Check whether the repository needs setup, has a 6.x layout, or is already configured.
Preview and apply a 6.x migration that archives legacy files and removes old instruction blocks.
Initialize a new project with an optional verification command and an option to omit the AGENTS.md note.
Record the project goal and next action in STATE.md.
Run the project check and report missing hook registrations with suggested fixes.
limitations: Requires an environment that can run npx and access the Godpowers npm package.
Targets Godpowers version 7 and documents migration from 6.x only.
Stops after the status check when the repository is already set up.
The workflow does not pin an exact package version or require approval after the migration preview.

use_cases.title: Set Up a New Repository
use_cases.description: Initialize Godpowers, record the first project goal, and verify the repository check.

use_cases.title: Review a 6.x Migration
use_cases.description: Preview the legacy files and instruction blocks affected before approving a migration.

use_cases.title: Run Setup Checks During Onboarding
use_cases.description: Check whether a repository is configured and report verification and hook results when setup is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Godpowers
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Godpowers in this repository. Record the goal as improving test coverage and the next step as adding tests for the login form.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: initialize a project with a known goal.

prompt_templates.title: Keep AGENTS.md Unchanged During Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize Godpowers without adding a note to AGENTS.md. Record the project goal and tell me whether the verification and hook checks pass.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: initialize without adding the optional instruction note.

prompt_templates.title: Use an Approved Project Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize Godpowers and show me the exact project check before running it. Wait for my approval and report any missing hook registrations afterward.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review the verification command during setup.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a 6.x Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this is a Godpowers 6.x project. If so, preview the migration and list the affected files and instruction blocks. Stop before applying changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review the scope of a legacy migration.

output_examples.input: Set up Godpowers so we can add tests for the login form.
output_examples.output: Godpowers is initialized. STATE.md records improving login test coverage as the goal and adding the first login test as the next step. The project check passed, and the hooks are registered.

output_examples.input: Set up Godpowers in a repository that is already configured.
output_examples.output: This repository is already set up for Godpowers. Setup stopped after the status check.

best_practices: Use an exact reviewed package release and approve running it before the first status check.
Review the migration preview and approve changes before allowing the migration to proceed.
Confirm the exact project check command before it runs.
anti_patterns: Treating a status check or dry run as a sandbox for the npm package.
Applying migration before reviewing which shared instructions will change.
Running a project check copied from an untrusted source.

faq.question: What does this skill set up?
faq.answer: It initializes a Godpowers project, records the goal and next step, runs verification, and checks hook registration.

faq.question: What happens to an existing 6.x project?
faq.answer: The skill previews migration and then applies it by default. The migration archives legacy files and removes old instruction blocks from shared agent and editor files.

faq.question: What happens if Godpowers is already configured?
faq.answer: The skill reports that setup is complete and stops without running initialization or the later checks.

faq.question: Can I skip the note in AGENTS.md?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask the skill to omit the AGENTS.md note during initialization. This option does not prevent a 6.x migration from removing legacy instruction blocks.

faq.question: Can I supply a verification command?
faq.answer: Yes. When setup cannot detect a check command, you can supply one. Review the exact command before it runs.

faq.question: Does the skill run software from npm?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow uses npx to run the Godpowers package from major version 7. The skill does not pin an exact release.
